title: Hold working with children checks
what: Make sure people doing child-related work hold the state's working with children check (or equivalent).

laws.title: Working with Children (Risk Management and Screening) Act 2000

sources.title: Application for a blue card
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need a blue card to work, volunteer or operate a business with or involving children unless a valid exemption applies.
